issues.detail: The instructions do not cover error handling or edge cases.

scenarios.name: add-proxied-a-record
scenarios.rationale: Response A fully meets the rubric, while Response B omits the required environment variable references.

scenarios.name: terraform-dns-record
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers most rubric items but omits the full name 'www.example.com'; Response B fails key requirements by using the old resource name and not reading the token from the environment.

scenarios.name: deploy-hello-worker
scenarios.rationale: Response A includes the required src/index.js with an exported fetch handler and a route configuration, whereas Response B uses an event listener and omits the export; both miss the jsonc format, route array, and dev command, but A is closer to the rubric.
